rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for conditions or a period before industrialization.

example.english: People in preindustrial societies mainly relied on manual labour and animals.
example.traditional: 工業化之前嘅社會主要靠人手同牲畜做嘢。

rows.jyutping: mei6 gung1 jip6 faa3 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when a country, region, or society has not yet become industrialized.

example.english: Preindustrial countries often do not yet have well-developed railway networks.
example.traditional: 未工業化嘅國家仲未有完善嘅鐵路網絡。
